source.underlying_source: Title Guaranty of Hawaii, Inc. based on Hawaii DLNR Bureau of Conveyances data; calculations by DBEDT

notes: Edition: the 2025 State of Hawaii Data Book (58th edition) is released, Excel-only (DBEDT: PDF formats are no longer available); DB2025_section21.xlsx HTTP Last-Modified 2026-09-29. The 2025 edition RENUMBERED the home-sales tables: by type = 21.36, by origin statewide = 21.37, by origin by county = 21.38 (21.39 is now foreclosure filings). In the 2015-2024 editions they were 21.37 / 21.38 / 21.39.

Definitions (Data Book/QSER): home sales = recorded sales of single-family homes and condominiums compiled by Title Guaranty of Hawaii from DLNR Bureau of Conveyances data; origin of buyer (local / mainland / foreign) is as classified by Title Guaranty; the Data Book and QSER tables do not state how origin is determined, so do not describe it as legal residency. Average price = total sales amount / number of sales (footnote 1/ / [a]). Averages are means, not medians.

statewide rows 2008-2025: total/sf/condo/avg_total/avg_sf/avg_condo from DB2025 Table 21.36; local/mainland/foreign and their averages from DB2025 Table 21.37 (averages carry 2 decimals in the source; rounded to whole dollars here). local+mainland+foreign == total and sf+condo == total verified for every year. No edition-to-edition revisions >$1 / >1 sale were found in statewide 21.37/21.38 across the 2015-2025 editions (they only append years).

county rows 2016-2025 come from the newest Data Book edition that prints that year (2023-2025: DB2025 Table 21.38; 2022: DB2023 21.39; 2021: DB2022 21.39; 2020: DB2021; 2019: DB2020; 2018: DB2019; 2017: DB2018; 2016: DB2017 21.39, identical to DB2016). Each Data Book edition prints only the latest 1-3 years per county.

county rows 2008-2015 are NOT available single-year in any Data Book: the 2015 edition's Table 21.39 is a pooled 2008-2015 aggregate. Those rows are taken from DBEDT's Quarterly Statistical & Economic Report (QSER) 3rd Quarter 2026, Tables G-49..G-52 (by type) and G-53..G-56 (by origin), which DBEDT cites as the source series for 21.38/21.39. Check: QSER annual 2008-2015 sums exactly reproduce every count and the count-weighted local average in the DB2015 pooled table (checks.db2015_2008_2015_aggregate_vs_qser_sums).

County single-family/condo split (sf, condo, avg_sf, avg_condo) is not in the Data Book; it comes from QSER G-49..G-52 for all years (type_basis). County counts sum exactly to the statewide totals in every year 2008-2025, and count-weighted county averages reproduce the statewide averages within $1 after the correction below.

DATA BOOK TYPO (corrected): Honolulu County 2019 average price for local buyers is printed as $667,292 in the 2019 and 2020 editions (XLS and PDF). QSER G-53 gives $677,292.29. Only $677,292 reproduces the published statewide 2019 local average ($622,960; implied $622,959.9 vs $616,050.3 with the printed value), so the county row uses 677,292 and keeps the printed value under data_book_printed.

DATA BOOK REVISION: Maui County 2021 local-buyer average was printed as $478,509 in the 2021 edition and revised to $978,509.44 in the 2022 edition (footnote 2/ 'Revised from previous Data Book'); the revised value is used and matches QSER G-55.

The 2017 Data Book edition did not update these tables: 21.37/21.38 are titled '2008 TO 2016' and 21.39 repeats 2016 county data (same as the 2016 edition). 2017 county data first appear in the 2018 edition.

QSER 3rd Quarter 2026 (released ~2026-09-10; data through 2nd quarter 2026) is the latest residency-of-buyer source: E-11/E-12 statewide and G-49..G-56 by county, annual 2008-2025 plus quarterly 2008Q1-2026Q2. QSER annual 2008-2025 values equal the DB2025 statewide values for every field. Quarterly rows 2024Q1-2026Q2 are included in qser_quarterly_2024q1_2026q2; quarterly counts sum to the annual counts for every county/year 2008-2025.

QSER labeling error handled: sheet G-55 (Maui, by origin) labels the 2022 first-quarter row '2021 1 Qtr.'; quarters were assigned sequentially (Q1 after a Q4 = next year). With that, Maui 2021 and 2022 quarters sum to the annual figures.

Kauai QSER quarterly averages show '(X)' (not applicable) when the count is 0 (e.g. foreign buyers 2025Q1, 2025Q3); these are null in the output. Small-cell caution: county foreign-buyer averages rest on very few sales (e.g. Kauai foreign 2025 n=2, avg $1,065,567; Maui foreign 2025 n=16; Kauai foreign 2025Q2 is a single sale averaging $51,133) and swing wildly; do not chart them without the count.
qser_h1_2025_vs_h1_2026_derived is computed here (not published): counts = Q1+Q2 sums; averages = count-weighted means of the quarterly averages (equivalent to total dollars / total sales).
2026 annual data do not exist yet (the 2026 Data Book will not appear until ~mid/late 2027); the latest full year is 2025.

Comparison with an/page_data.json (tg): all 716 numeric values present in page_data match the new data (counts exactly, averages within $1 rounding). The only discrepancy versus a PRINTED Data Book figure is Honolulu 2019 avg_local (page_data 677,292 = correct; Data Book prints 667,292). page_data lacks sf/condo fields for State 2008-2014 (now available from DB2025 21.36) and has no county rows for 2008-2014 (now available from QSER G-tables).
No owner names or addresses are involved: these are published aggregates only.
